related_questions.question: How much will I have if I invest $1000 a month for 30 years?
related_questions.snippet: Investing $1,000 per month for 30 years at a 6% rate of return hypothetically will give you an investment portfolio worth more than $1 million. This result is hypothetical because it doesn't take into account taxes, fees, varying rates of return and other variables, such as extended market downturns.
